Commentary.Commentary: The pitch is flat, the ground is small, the outfield is quick and there might be dew on offer. In spite of all these factors, 382 might just be a hurdle too high for the English. Join us in a while for the run chase.

Not much to speak about the English bowlers. Apart from Woakes, no one looked threatening and only Morgan can explain why David Willey bowled only 5 overs. When everyone was getting hit, he might have as well experimented by giving the left-armer one over at least, during the Yuvi-Dhoni stand.

England had a great start with the ball, as Woakes removed the top order in a jiffy. But the 256-run stand between Yuvraj and Dhoni completely put England out of the game. Yuvraj was at his best, smashing 150 out of 127 balls, while Dhoni, albeit he was cramping, put in 134 of his own. The stand started at a run rate of under 4 and finished at a value of 6.67. Woakes got a 4-fer but he would have preferred to have got Yuvraj's wicket as well.
Terrific batting display by the hosts. Actually that is an understatement. From 25/3 to recover to post 381 is simply outstanding.
An anti-climatic end. A short ball outside leg, Jadeja looks to hook but misses. He expects a wide but does not get it. A dot ball to end the proceedings and INDIA FINISH ON A COMMANDING 381/6!
SIX! This is even better! Mid off is inside the ring and and Jadeja leans and lofts it over mid off and clears the ropes!
FOUR! What a flick! Full and on the pads, Jadeja flicks it wide of long on and gets a boundary!
A slower ball on middle, Pandya gets across and looks to scoop but gets a top edge. The ball drops in front of fine leg and and the batsmen take a run.
Another full toss wide outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
A full toss outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
CHRIS WOAKES to bowl the final over. India will be eying 380.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Jake Ball is having his arm tended to.

DROPPED! That is a tough call. Full and outside off, Pandya smashes this straight back. Jake Ball is lucky to put his hand in front of his face and the ball goes off his palm to long off. A single taken.
Full and wide outside off, chipped over covers for a single.
It's been lofted over mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Pandya smashes this straight back over mid off and gets a boundary!
A full toss outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
RAVINDRA JADEJA walks in at number 8, replacing Dhoni.

OUT! Excellent catch in the deep! A length ball outside off, Dhoni pulls it over mid-wicket. David Willey times his jump to perfection at the ropes and takes it nicely. What a knock from the former Indian skipper. Old memories relived.
SIX! What a shot! Full and wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out and lofts it over covers for a biggie!
WIDE. Down the leg side, Dhoni misses his flick.
The physio has been called for by Dhoni. Looks like he is cramping on the left hand.
SIX! HUMONGOUS! A short ball outside off, Dhoni swivels and pulls it over mid-wicket!
Another full toss, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! That is just a whip! A full toss on middle, Dhoni comes forward and whips it miles over mid-wicket!
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, Hardik swats it towards mid-wicket. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end and Pandya and Ball collide. Nothing serious. A single in the end.
WIDE. Goes for a similar ball, but this time Ball's ball is wide outside the guidelines and HP cannot reach.
Full and wide outside off, Hardik slashes hard but misses.

DROPPED, SIX! And Stokes cops one on the lips as well! A short ball outside off, Pandya looks to pull but miscues this over mid-wicket. Ben Stokes times his jump for the catch at the ropes but the ball bursts through his hands and goes into the crowd! Hang on, there is more. Stokes is not paying attention and looks back to retrieve the ball but then someone throws the ball back at that time and he is hit on the lips. No one's mistake really. Poor Stokes is not impressed and has some harsh words to say to the person who threw the ball.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A full toss outside off, Pandya stands his ground and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary!
Full and wide outside off, squeezed through point for a single.
JAKE BALL comes back on to bowl.
HARDIK PANDYA comes in at number 7, replacing Jadhav.

OUT! Straight to the man! A slower full toss outside off, Jadhav is early into his heave and mistimes it towards short mid-wicket. Jake Ball comes forward and takes a neat catch. Excellent cameo from Jadhav.
FOUR! Cheeky! A short ball outside off, Jadhav arches back and guides it over the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence!
SIX! What a shot! A cross-seamer, served on a length outside off, Jadhav just lofts this straight through the line and makes the ball land in front of the sight screen!
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
WIDE. A length ball down the leg side, Dhoni misses out on the pull.
Another slower ball on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and down the leg side, clipped behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! A slower ball, fuller in length outside off, Jadhav waits for the ball to come and pulls it over a leaping Eoin Morgan at short mid-wicket for a boundary!
A short ball outside off, pulled wide of long on for a couple.

FOUR! FETCH THAT! Full and straight, Dhoni smashes this straight back and Jadhav has to duck to avoid getting hit. Is there any point in mentioning where the ball went? 300 UP FOR INDIA! 360 is definitely on the cards.
Full and around off, pushed down to long on for a single.

Full on middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end and concedes an overthrow. The return from the long off fielder hits Jos Buttler on his pads and deflects further away. Dhoni looks for the second but it is not available.
BEN STOKES comes back on to bowl.
FOUR! Deftly done! A short ball outside off, Jadhav arches back and guides it over the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence! 15 from the over!
Full and straight, defended back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
WIDE. A length ball down the leg side, MS misses his flick.
FOUR BYES! Bowled off a free hit. A length ball outside off, Dhoni swings hard but misses. The ball hits the off stump and then flies over Jos Buttler to the fence behind!
FREE HIT coming up!
NO BALL! Woakes oversteps and bowls it full and down the leg side, Dhoni flicks it through square leg for a couple.
A short ball outside off, Jadhav gets in line way too early to pull and comfortably helps it behind square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes back on to bowl.
KEDAR JADHAV comes in at number 6, replacing Yuvraj.

OUT! Caught behind! Yuvraj finally falls. Woakes has his fourth. A full ball wide outside off, Yuvraj looks to drive this through the covers but the feet do not move as much and he gets a thick nick to the keeper. He departs for a wonderful 150 from just 127 balls. Deserved a double there. The crowd stands as one. What a knock. Take a bow. Can England come back from here?
10th ODI ton for Dhoni, first against England!

CENTURY FOR DHONI! Almost a catch as well. A short ball outside off, Dhoni pulls this towards deep square leg. Alex Hales gets across from deep mid-wicket but the ball drops just in front of him. A single taken.
Full and outside off,  smashed straight to cover.
A short ball outside off, Dhoni looks to hook but misses.
SIX! This one is definitely not a no ball! A length ball outside off, Dhoni swings this miles over long on! He smiles as he punches gloves with Yuvi.
What happened there? DEAD BALL SIGNALLED! Dhoni pulls a high full toss over mid-wicket but then the ball hits a cable and drops down! The umpire immediately signals it a dead ball.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
A slower one, full and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for one more.
150 FOR YUVRAJ! Full and outside off, Yuvraj pushes this towards long off for another single.
Full and outside off, Dhoni blasts this straight back. Stokes tries to stop it but the ball bursts through his hands and hits him on his chest and deflects to the off side. A run taken.
A yorker outside off, dug out towards cover for one.
A high full toss outside off, slapped through the covers for a run.
Full and wide outside off, eased over cover for a single.
A full toss outside off, steered straight to point.

NOT OUT! It has bounced. Full and wide outside off, Yuvraj looks to run it down to third man and Buttler gets across to his left and takes it. England appeal for the catch and the umpire raises his finger! Yuvraj immediately signals for the review but tells Dhoni he is not sure. Replays show that there is an outside edge but the ball bounces on its way to Buttler. The crowd roars as the decision is reversed. Another replay says that Dhoni signalled for the review first!
Yuvraj has been adjudged caught behind! He takes the review.
Excellent fielding. Full and outside off, MS hammers it wide of mid off but Ben Stokes gets across to his left and dives to stop the ball. A single taken.
FOUR! A short ball around middle, Dhoni gets across and pulls. Does not time it cleanly and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat to the fine leg fence.
A short ball around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and wide outside off, angling away, Yuvraj tries to reach out and drive but misses.
POWERPLAY 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. How much can England restrict India to? 375 could be attained here.
Full and wide outside off, hit towards cover for a run.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Yuvi flays this over covers for a single.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! Full and on middle and leg, Yuvraj lofts this over mid on and comfortably clears long on! Moves to 143 and this is now his best ODI score, eclipsing his 139 against Australia in Sydney in 2004! Can he get a double century?
WIDE. Goes for the yorker but bowls this down the leg side, fuller in length. Yuvraj misses out on his flick.
FOUR! Poor bowling, full and down the leg side, tickled to the fine leg fence!
Full and wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out to slash but gets a top edge which lands safely in front of the man running in from sweeper cover. A single taken.
BEN STOKES is back on.
Full and wide outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Dhoni reaches out to drive but misses.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
SIX! Fine shot! A short ball outside off, Yuvraj pulls this wide of mid on and clears the ropes as well!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Yuvraj is signalling for a change in bat here. He is not happy with the current one. Amit Mishra comes running in with one bat. Umesh Yadav brings out another one. Yuvraj finally selects one.
FOUR! This is batting of very high quality. Full and outside off, Yuvraj just chips this over cover, wide of mid off and gets another boundary! 11 from the over!
FOUR! This is vintage Yuvraj. Ball bowls this short and outside off, Yuvraj just dismisses this from his presence with a fine pull over mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Dhoni gets across and pulls it through square leg. Liam Plunkett gets across to his left from short fine leg and dives to stop the ball. Just a run taken.

Comes down the track and slices this over covers for a single.

MISCUE, SIX! A short ball outside off, Dhoni comes down the track and looks to pull but gets a top edge. However, it still sails over long on! How small a ground is this or how big is that edge of his bat?

EDGED, FOUR! Half century for Dhoni. He has been living a charmed life in the last 15 minutes but he has done well. Full and wide outside off, Dhoni throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies past the diving Jos Buttler to the third man fence!

LEADING EDGE, DROPPED, FOUR! What a stroke of luck for Dhoni. He comes down the track and looks to flick but gets a massive leading edge which balloons towards long on. Jake Ball runs back from mid on, keeps his eyes on the ball but still loses it. The ball brushes his hands and drops down and he further pushes it into the ropes. Insult to injury.

A short ball on middle and leg, Mahendra looks to pull but the ball goes off his gloves to short fine leg. Yuvraj smiles at the other end.

Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
YUVRAJ SINGH walks in at number 4, replacing Kohli.

OUT! Kohli has gone cheaply today! Big, big wicket for England. This is very full outside off, a touch wider, perhaps Kohli thinks it is a yorker and looks to dig it out. But he is fooled by the length and ends up just pushing at the ball. The bat hits the ground and the ball takes the outside edge towards second slip. Ben Stokes gets across to his left, fumbles in the first attempt but then takes it in the second. Woakes is cock-a-hoop. The umpire checks for the overstepping but replays show that Woakes is fine. Kohli has to go. What an over - 2 wickets, 2 boundaries!
Full and outside off, VK steers and pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Just a mere push! Full and outside off, Kohli just pushes this down the ground and this is even straighter than the previous one! Get the ball back please!
Full and outside off, Virat looks to work it towards mid on but the bat turns in his hand and the ball deflects towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! BRILLIANT! Kohli continues from where he left off in the last game. Half volley outside off, Kohli comes forward and drives this straight down the ground. Mid off has no chance.
The skipper of the Indian team, VIRAT KOHLI, walks in at number 3, replacing Rahul. Fresh from a wonderful century in the last game.

OUT! Edged and taken! Woakes has the first strike! A lovely delivery. Lands this in the avenue of apprehension, which is around an area near the 4th stump. This means that the batsman has to play at it and Rahul does. The length is somewhere between full and good, which further means that the batsman cannot leave it, assuming that the ball will go over the stumps. So Rahul looks to play. But at the last moment, the ball moves away and takes the outside edge. It dips on its way to second slip where Ben Stokes takes a very good catch above the surface. Woakes is pumped up and why not? Early break for England again.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and wide outside off, Shikhar looks to drive but misses. There was no movement of the feet there.
FOUR! Action replay! Similar ball, Dhawan once again strides forward and just strokes this through the covers for boundaries in succession!
FOUR! BEAUTY! Full and outside off, slightly wide, Dhawan leans and drives it between cover and mid off for a boundary!
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, left alone.
DAVID WILLEY will bowl with the other new ball.
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to the man at cover.
On middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a single.
Outside off, no boundary this time, in fact no shot played at all.
FOUR! Awesome! Terrific start to the game for India! Full and wide outside off, Rahul leans and drives it through the covers. It finds the gap and the boundary!
The players are out in the middle. Shikhar Dhawan and Lokesh Rahul are the openers for India. It will be CHRIS WOAKES to start off proceedings to Rahul. Here we go.
We are all set for the national anthems. The English one first up. The anthems are done and dusted and we are ready for the play to begin.

Kohli says that toss is not on anyone's control. He won the toss in the first ODI but ended up conceding a huge total and still, chased it down. Further says that is why you need to execute skills perfectly. On the surface, he says that it looks very good, so is looking forward to put in a good total. Is very much happy with the result of the last game, especially after having been 63/4 at one stage. Also says that it shows how good a batting depth India have. Informs that India also have made one change, bringing in Bhuvneshwar Kumar for Umesh Yadav.

Morgan says that it looks a pretty good wicket and pretty much similar to that played in the first ODI. Stresses that in spite of the loss, the morale in the team is pretty high. Again says that the batting was not totally perfect given the dimensions of the ground. He hopes to restrict India to somewhere around 320 today. Informs that England have made one change - Adil Rashid has been left out due to the small dimensions of the ground and Liam Plunkett has been drafted in.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Virat Kohli flips it, Tails is the call from Morgan and it turns out to be Tails. ENGLAND OPT TO CHASE.
WEATHER REPORT - It is scorching hot in Cuttack but expect the temperatures to cool down once the sun sets.

We have barely recovered from India's thrilling run chase in the first ODI and the second game is already upon us. England would be massively demoralized after losing in spite of scoring a massive total but they need to turn it around today. It is a do-or-die match for them as another loss would end the series for them. India, on the other hand, will aim to seal the series today with a focus to improve their bowling. Hello and a warm welcome to the second ODI between India and England at the Barabati Stadium, Cuttack.
